claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this cationic amphiphilic sigma ligand most plausibly kills cells through nonspecific lysosomal/physicochemical stress rather than sigma-receptor-mediated cytotoxicity, likely producing weak, broad killing.
